meaning:
ἀπο-πλανάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָדַח hi., נָטָה hi., שׁוּב pi. ;]
to cause to go astray; metaphorically, of leading into error: Mrk.13:22; pass., to be led astray: 1Ti.6:10.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For there will arise false christs and false prophets, and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many…
